description: Create house.borrowed_book, the list of books currently out of the house.
rationale: Also in the way on purpose: 0099 renames the column underneath it. A rename repairs the view definition by itself, but the view keeps its OWN output column name -- so the view still exposes borrowed_by after the column becomes borrowed_by_friend, and nothing errors to say so.

intents.name: borrowed_book
intents.comment: Books that are out on loan, oldest loan first.
intents.definition: SELECT b.item_id, b.title, b.author, b.isbn, b.borrowed_by, b.borrowed_on, CURRENT_DATE - b.borrowed_on AS days_out FROM house.book AS b WHERE b.borrowed_by IS NOT NULL
